(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the method is performed by a computing device configured to process the unique identifier and the stored user information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user, wherein the second unique identifier is received by the computing device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 23: The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of the user identified by the second unique identifier.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for the user identified by the second unique identifier.
